C0023.title: 3,000 'Click Farmers' Generated 200,000 Fake Reviews: Zibo Police Dismantle Rampant Traffic Fraud Ring
C0023.summary: Zibo police uncovered a large-scale fake order scheme operated by a tightly organized criminal group controlling both merchant and 'click farmer' resources. Using numerous fake accounts and simulated transactions, they fabricated purchase records to generate positive reviews for merchants.
